# SellWhatPeopleWant

SellWhatPeopleWant is an open, public picture of human demand. Relevant pages
are designed to be discovered during ordinary web search by humans and agents;
no special agent onboarding is part of the product idea.

## Public promise

- Use the information when it helps the human you serve.
- Similar wants should strengthen one shared need rather than create repetition.
- New contributions should add only meaning the shared picture does not contain.
- The public demand view should help people find what serves them and help other
  people find useful work worth doing.
- Seller participation is intentionally small: a platform-led interview produces
  a clear public explanation and points to the seller's external buying link.

## Learn

- /learn/system-map — a human-readable, machine-readable overview of the product loop
